replay_engine.choice: T4-style bar-replay (backtest/tools/t4_exit_matrix.py + backtest/tools/structure_stop_study.py pattern): ATM option bars loaded ONCE per signal via lib.option_pricing_real.load_contract_bars/option_symbol + autoresearch.infinite_ammo_discovery._nearest_cached_strike (<=4-step snap, same convention as the ratified ship-gate study), then EVERY exit shape in the grid is replayed cheaply through the LIVE automation/state/fleet/exit_manager.plan_exit_actions decision core -- the SAME pure core the live actuator runs and exit_shape_parity_study/structure_stop_study use for their anchors.
replay_engine.why_not_simulate_trade_real_for_the_whol: simulate_trade_real (the C1 fills authority used by the walk-forward/ship-gate studies) has no native concept of a VWAP-based structure stop -- it only supports a fixed chart-stop level (session extreme) via rejection_level. Running 24 cells against it would also mean the structure-stop cells use a DIFFERENT engine than the premium-stop cells within the SAME grid, which is less internally consistent than one uniform replay engine across all 24 cells. T4 chose plan_exit_actions for exactly this reason (it is also the LIVE decision core, so results are directly actionable).
replay_engine.entry_fill_convention: Entry = the first ATM option bar with timestamp_et >= (trigger_bar.timestamp_et + 5min), price = that bar's OPEN, frictionless (no slippage modelled) -- mirrors t4_exit_matrix._load_bars' own frictionless-open convention. This is the SAME 'next bar after the trigger, no look-ahead' timing simulate_trade_real uses internally (verified by reading simulate_trade_real lines 388-398: 'next_bar_start = entry_time + timedelta(minutes=5); entry_bar_opt = bar_at_or_after(...)'), but WITHOUT simulate_trade_real's small entry_slippage add-on -- disclosed gap, not faked.
replay_engine.parity_check_required: Before any grid cell is trusted, replay the CONTROL cell (this file's live_cell_as_of_freeze shape) through BOTH engines (this bar-replay AND lib.simulator_real.simulate_trade_real, the latter exactly as vwapcont_exit_ab_ship_gate.py calls it) on the OLD window signals (<=2026-05-15) and quote the delta. A large, unexplained delta means STOP and diagnose before trusting the grid -- mirrors the parity_gate pattern used throughout this codebase (vwapcont_exit_ab_ship_gate.py's own $0.75/tr tolerance, structure_stop_study.py's preflight anchor-parity check).
replay_engine.time_stop: 15:50 ET (exit_manager.TIME_STOP_ET, the live default AND simulate_trade_real's own TIME_STOP_ET default) -- NOT ribbon_ride's T4/T5 convention of 15:40; vwap_continuation's own studies and the live engine both use 15:50.

stops.STRUCT: 5m SPY CLOSE back through the AS-OF session VWAP (not a fixed level) + -50% premium catastrophe cap -- see structure_definition below

exit_grid.cap_note: the raw cartesian product of the given axes is 5(stops incl. STRUCT) x 2(tp1) x 2(frac) x 2(lock) = 40 cells. Capped at 24 per the task's instruction via a REDUCED design: full pairwise crosses of every axis against the STOP axis (stop x tp1, stop x lock, stop x frac) relative to CONTROL, all three remaining pairwise crosses at the control stop (tp1 x frac, tp1 x lock, frac x lock), ONE 4-way 'kitchen sink' widened cell, and a small 4-cell structure-stop family mirroring the ribbon_ride SS-A/B/C precedent (structure_stop_study.py) rather than crossing STRUCT against every tp1/frac/lock combination. This is NOT a full factorial -- disclosed, not hidden.

structure_definition.task_instruction: vwap setups may anchor to VWAP itself rather than a key level -- implement price closing back through VWAP as the structure variant (task's own words, not re-derived)
structure_definition.choice_made: AS-OF (dynamically recomputed) session VWAP, NOT a value frozen at entry. Every subsequent 5m SPY bar's CLOSE is compared against THAT bar's own cumulative session VWAP (identical formula to autoresearch.infinite_ammo_discovery.session_vwap_asof / the watcher's _session_rth_vwap: typical-price*volume cumulative / volume cumulative).
structure_definition.why_asof_not_frozen: The entry gate itself is defined relative to the AS-OF vwap (trend_side + continuation trigger both read vwap[j] at the trigger bar j, not a fixed number). The honest mirror of 'this setup's own invalidation test' is the SAME as-of comparison run forward in time, not a level frozen at entry (freezing it would silently convert a VWAP-relative setup into a level-relative one, which is what ribbon_ride's structure stop already covers via SS-A/B/C -- vwap_continuation's differentiator IS that its reference point moves with volume). Disclosed alternative NOT implemented: freezing VWAP at the entry bar (arguable, but re-introduces a level-stop that already exists for ribbon_ride and stops being a distinctively VWAP-relative test).
structure_definition.breach_condition: calls (side C): breach on the first 5m bar whose CLOSE < that bar's as-of session VWAP (strict). puts (side P): breach on the first 5m bar whose CLOSE > that bar's as-of session VWAP (strict). Buffer = $0.00 (matches SS-A/SS-B's buffer=0, not SS-C's $0.10 -- no buffer variant is in-scope for this reduced 24-cell grid).
structure_definition.c6_fill_mark_convention: IDENTICAL to structure_stop_study.py: the structure stop fires at the NEXT 5m bar's OPEN premium (not the close-bar's own closing premium) -- the breach is only knowable once the bar closes, so the earliest tradeable price is the next bar's open. Within a bar, a due structure-stop is checked BEFORE the ordinary touch-based checks (catastrophe stop / TP1 / trail / time stop).
structure_definition.catastrophe_cap: -50% premium stop, same CATASTROPHE_STOP_PCT convention as exit_manager.py and ribbon_ride's SS-A/B/C -- protects a structure-stop position between the VWAP breach and its next-bar-open fill, and protects it entirely if the VWAP check never fires (e.g. VWAP data unavailable for a bar).
structure_definition.spy_bar_granularity: 5-min SPY bars (same cache tw8_level_context/t4/structure_stop_study already use) -- NOT the live engine's finer feed. Option bars are ALSO 5-min (backtest/data/options/ cache), consistent with the rest of this grid.

policies.description: pay-up at the signal bar's fill convention (this study's own control entry -- the SAME entry every exit-grid cell above uses)

T3 convention (backtest/tools/t3_entry_matrix.py entry_fill): limit at signal_premium*(1-0.05), filled if a bar's LOW <= limit-$0.01 within 2 five-minute bars of the signal, else MISSED and priced at $0 (honest -- not silently dropped, not converted to a market fill).

entry_probes.exit_pairing_rule: control exit (P1T1F1L1, this file's live_cell_as_of_freeze shape) x BOTH entry policies, PLUS the exit_grid's TOP-RANKED cell (by fresh-tail expectancy, tie-break by IS expectancy -- an OBJECTIVE post-hoc rule fixed HERE before the grid is run, not a hand-picked exit) x BOTH entry policies = 4 cells total. This rule is pre-registered so which exit shape gets paired with the entry probe is never a judgment call made after seeing results.
entry_probes.miss_pricing: misses priced at $0 exactly like t3_entry_matrix.py -- expectancy-including-misses is the adjudicating metric, NOT filled-only expectancy (a passive entry that gets great filled-only numbers by skipping every loser is not evidence of an edge).

real_fills_anchor.source_instruction: find them via the parity-study fills source filtered to strategy=vwap_continuation; if too few for an anchor, DISCLOSE and mark INCONCLUSIVE-ANCHOR (task's own words)
real_fills_anchor.scope: BOTH lanes -- fleet_rest arms (safe-1/3, risky-1/3, strategies.py VWAP_CONTINUATION) AND core arms (safe-2, bold-2, params.json j_vwap_cont_* via heartbeat_core._SETUP_EXIT_OVERRIDES) -- 'this month' = 2026-07
real_fills_anchor.fallback_rule: if the live fills ledger (automation/state/fills-ledger.jsonl) carries no per-fill strategy/setup attribution that can be joined back to individual vwap_continuation entries with reasonable confidence, OR the recoverable population is too thin (n<5 positions) to say anything, the anchor layer is marked INCONCLUSIVE-ANCHOR with the exact reason stated -- it does NOT silently pass or silently fail candidates. A cell cannot be reported PASS on the anchor condition while the anchor is INCONCLUSIVE; the pass bar treats an inconclusive anchor as the anchor condition being UNMET (conservative: CONTROL STANDS unless the anchor genuinely confirms).

pass_bar.statement: A challenger exit-grid cell REPLACES the live control cell in this study's verdict ONLY if ALL FOUR hold simultaneously: (1) beats control on IS (2025) per-trade expectancy; (2) beats control on the NEVER-TOUCHED fresh tail (2026-05-18..2026-07-08) per-trade expectancy; (3) its own drop-top-3 expectancy is POSITIVE; (4) the real-fills anchor shows no regression vs control (or the anchor is INCONCLUSIVE, in which case condition 4 is treated as UNMET, not vacuously true). Otherwise: CONTROL STANDS -- itself a valid, reportable verdict, not a failure of the study.
pass_bar.ranking_among_passers: if more than one cell clears all four conditions, rank by fresh-tail expectancy (the least-contaminated evidence -- IS and the old OOS window were both already visible to the two prior vwap_continuation studies), tie-break by full-window (2025-01-01..2026-07-08) expectancy.
pass_bar.no_repicks: this pass bar and the 24+4 cell list above are FROZEN at this file's frozen_at date. No cell may be added, removed, or have its shape edited after any replay result is seen. A v2 amendment (like ribbon_ride's v1->v2) requires a written reason logged in an amendment_log block, made BEFORE re-running anything.

disclosures: 5-min OPRA bars (touch-based stops/TP1/structure checks; 1-min close timing not modelled here -- same disclosed gap as every T3/T4/T5/structure_stop_study precedent in this codebase).

Frictionless entry fills at the next-bar open (no bid/ask spread modelled) for the ENTIRE exit grid -- consistent with T4's own convention, but a departure from simulate_trade_real's small entry_slippage add-on (quantified via the required parity check above).

qty=3 (matches vwap_continuation's OWN established convention across edgehunt/walkforward/ship-gate -- NOT ribbon_ride's qty=10), so edge_capture and totals are directly comparable to the prior vwap scorecards' dollar figures, not merely relative.
ATM strike only (strike_offset=0, the LIVE Safe-2/Bold-2 cell, C29) -- ITM/OTM tiers are NOT covered by this grid (matches the ship-gate study's own C29 scope limit).

ribbon-flip-back / level-stop / chart-TP1 machinery in exit_manager.plan_exit_actions is left OFF (ribbon_flip_back=False always) for every cell including the structure-stop family -- the structure check here is a NEW layer in front of plan_exit_actions (mirrors structure_stop_study.py exactly), not a change to plan_exit_actions' own internal ribbon-flip logic.
Fresh-tail is SMALL BY CONSTRUCTION (n=14 signals / 35 trading days) -- any fresh-tail win is suggestive at this N, not proof; stated plainly in the final verdict, not buried.
The exit grid is a REDUCED design (24 of 40 possible axis combinations), not a full cartesian -- see exit_grid.cap_note.

Not run here (owed elsewhere, per the task's own scope): 1m-close vs 5m-close vs touch stop timing; ATR-scaled/delta-mapped chart stops; ITM/OTM strike tiers; a joint entry x exit grid beyond the 4 pre-registered pairs; P5-gate membership (this is ANALYSIS ONLY -- no wiring, no staging params; the P5 shipping gate is a separate concern for whoever the reviewer routes a challenger to).
